```{r cars}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

# =====================================================
# Preparar datos
# =====================================================
biomasa_parcela <- datos %>%
  group_by(IdConglome) %>%
  summarise(
    biomasa_total_kg = sum(biomasa_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    agbd = mean(agbd, na.rm = TRUE),
    rh95 = mean(rh95, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(biomasa_Mg_ha = biomasa_total_kg / 1000) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(agbd),
    !is.na(biomasa_Mg_ha),
    !is.na(rh95),
    biomasa_Mg_ha > 0,
    agbd > 0,
    rh95 > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_biomasa = log(biomasa_Mg_ha),
    log_agbd    = log(agbd),
    log_rh95    = log(rh95)
  )

# =====================================================
# Modelos
# =====================================================
mod_agbd_lin <- lm(biomasa_Mg_ha ~ agbd,     data = biomasa_parcela)
mod_agbd_log <- lm(log_biomasa   ~ log_agbd, data = biomasa_parcela)
mod_rh95_lin <- lm(biomasa_Mg_ha ~ rh95,     data = biomasa_parcela)
mod_rh95_log <- lm(log_biomasa   ~ log_rh95, data = biomasa_parcela)

# =====================================================
# Función para etiqueta de métricas
# =====================================================
metricas_label <- function(modelo, x, y) {
  r2   <- round(summary(modelo)$r.squared, 3)
  rmse <- round(sqrt(mean(resid(modelo)^2)), 3)
  cor_ <- round(cor(x, y), 3)
  paste0("R² = ", r2,
         "\nRMSE = ", rmse,
         "\nr = ", cor_)
}

lab_agbd_lin <- metricas_label(mod_agbd_lin,
                                biomasa_parcela$agbd,
                                biomasa_parcela$biomasa_Mg_ha)
lab_agbd_log <- metricas_label(mod_agbd_log,
                                biomasa_parcela$log_agbd,
                                biomasa_parcela$log_biomasa)
lab_rh95_lin <- metricas_label(mod_rh95_lin,
                                biomasa_parcela$rh95,
                                biomasa_parcela$biomasa_Mg_ha)
lab_rh95_log <- metricas_label(mod_rh95_log,
                                biomasa_parcela$log_rh95,
                                biomasa_parcela$log_biomasa)

# =====================================================
# Gráficas
# =====================================================
p1 <- ggplot(biomasa_parcela, aes(x = agbd, y = biomasa_Mg_ha)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
           label = lab_agbd_lin,
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3,
           size = 3.2, color = "gray20") +
  labs(x = "AGBD GEDI (Mg/ha)",
       y = "Biomasa INFyS (Mg/ha)",
       title = "Lineal – AGBD") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(biomasa_parcela, aes(x = rh95, y = biomasa_Mg_ha)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "forestgreen") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
           label = lab_rh95_lin,
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3,
           size = 3.2, color = "gray20") +
  labs(x = "RH95 GEDI (m)",
       y = "Biomasa INFyS (Mg/ha)",
       title = "Lineal – RH95") +
  theme_minimal()

p3 <- ggplot(biomasa_parcela, aes(x = log_agbd, y = log_biomasa)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
           label = lab_agbd_log,
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3,
           size = 3.2, color = "gray20") +
  labs(x = "log(AGBD GEDI)",
       y = "log(Biomasa INFyS)",
       title = "Log-Log – AGBD") +
  theme_minimal()

p4 <- ggplot(biomasa_parcela, aes(x = log_rh95, y = log_biomasa)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "forestgreen") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
           label = lab_rh95_log,
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3,
           size = 3.2, color = "gray20") +
  labs(x = "log(RH95 GEDI)",
       y = "log(Biomasa INFyS)",
       title = "Log-Log – RH95") +
  theme_minimal()

# =====================================================
# Panel final
# =====================================================
(p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Comparativo AGBD vs RH95 — GEDI x INFyS Quintana Roo 2019",
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(biomasa_parcela), " conglomerados"),
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40", size = 10)
    )
  )

```




A 100m 
```{r}
datos <- read_csv("C:/Users/katy/Downloads/INFYS_RH95_AGBD_Buffer1ha_2019_QROO_100.csv")
```



```{r}


# =====================================================
# 2. Sumar biomasa por parcela (1 ha)
# =====================================================
biomasa_parcela <- datos %>%
  group_by(IdConglome) %>%
  summarise(
    biomasa_total_kg = sum(biomasa_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    agbd = mean(agbd, na.rm = TRUE),
    rh95 = mean(rh95, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# =====================================================
# 3. Convertir kg → Mg (porque es 1 ha)
# =====================================================
biomasa_parcela <- biomasa_parcela %>%
  mutate(
    biomasa_Mg_ha = biomasa_total_kg / 1000
  )

# =====================================================
# 4. Revisar rango (control ecológico)
# =====================================================
summary(biomasa_parcela$biomasa_Mg_ha)
summary(biomasa_parcela$agbd)

# =====================================================
# 5. Eliminar NA
# =====================================================
biomasa_parcela <- biomasa_parcela %>%
  filter(!is.na(agbd),
         !is.na(biomasa_Mg_ha))

# =====================================================
# 6. Transformación logarítmica (evitar log(0))
# =====================================================
biomasa_parcela <- biomasa_parcela %>%
  filter(
    biomasa_Mg_ha > 0,
    agbd > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_biomasa = log(biomasa_Mg_ha),
    log_agbd    = log(agbd)
  )

# =====================================================
# 7. Modelo lineal original
# =====================================================
modelo_lin <- lm(biomasa_Mg_ha ~ agbd,
                 data = biomasa_parcela)

summary(modelo_lin)

# =====================================================
# 8. Modelo log-log
# =====================================================
modelo_log <- lm(log_biomasa ~ log_agbd,
                 data = biomasa_parcela)

summary(modelo_log)

# =====================================================
# 9. Métricas (modelo lineal)
# =====================================================
r2_lin <- summary(modelo_lin)$r.squared
cor_lin <- cor(biomasa_parcela$agbd,
               biomasa_parcela$biomasa_Mg_ha)

rmse_lin <- sqrt(mean(
  (biomasa_parcela$biomasa_Mg_ha -
     predict(modelo_lin))^2
))

cat("MODELO LINEAL\n")
cat("R² =", r2_lin, "\n")
cat("Correlación =", cor_lin, "\n")
cat("RMSE =", rmse_lin, "Mg/ha\n\n")

# =====================================================
# 10. Métricas (modelo log-log)
# =====================================================
r2_log <- summary(modelo_log)$r.squared
cor_log <- cor(biomasa_parcela$log_agbd,
               biomasa_parcela$log_biomasa)

rmse_log <- sqrt(mean(
  (biomasa_parcela$log_biomasa -
     predict(modelo_log))^2
))

cat("MODELO LOG-LOG\n")
cat("R² =", r2_log, "\n")
cat("Correlación =", cor_log, "\n")
cat("RMSE =", rmse_log, "\n\n")

# =====================================================
# 11. Forma funcional (escala original)
# =====================================================
alpha <- exp(coef(modelo_log)[1])
beta  <- coef(modelo_log)[2]

cat("Modelo potencia:\n")
cat("Biomasa =", alpha, "* AGBD^", beta, "\n\n")



```

```{r}
# =====================================================
# 14. Métricas RH95 vs Biomasa INFyS
# =====================================================
modelo_rh95_lin <- lm(biomasa_Mg_ha ~ rh95,
                      data = biomasa_parcela)

biomasa_parcela <- biomasa_parcela %>%
  filter(rh95 > 0) %>%
  mutate(log_rh95 = log(rh95))

modelo_rh95_log <- lm(log_biomasa ~ log_rh95,
                      data = biomasa_parcela)

# Métricas lineal
r2_rh95_lin  <- summary(modelo_rh95_lin)$r.squared
cor_rh95_lin <- cor(biomasa_parcela$rh95,
                    biomasa_parcela$biomasa_Mg_ha)
rmse_rh95_lin <- sqrt(mean(
  (biomasa_parcela$biomasa_Mg_ha -
     predict(modelo_rh95_lin))^2
))

cat("MODELO LINEAL – RH95\n")
cat("R² =", r2_rh95_lin, "\n")
cat("Correlación =", cor_rh95_lin, "\n")
cat("RMSE =", rmse_rh95_lin, "Mg/ha\n\n")

# Métricas log-log
r2_rh95_log  <- summary(modelo_rh95_log)$r.squared
cor_rh95_log <- cor(biomasa_parcela$log_rh95,
                    biomasa_parcela$log_biomasa)
rmse_rh95_log <- sqrt(mean(
  (biomasa_parcela$log_biomasa -
     predict(modelo_rh95_log))^2
))

cat("MODELO LOG-LOG – RH95\n")
cat("R² =", r2_rh95_log, "\n")
cat("Correlación =", cor_rh95_log, "\n")
cat("RMSE =", rmse_rh95_log, "\n\n")

# Forma funcional potencia
alpha_rh95 <- exp(coef(modelo_rh95_log)[1])
beta_rh95  <- coef(modelo_rh95_log)[2]
cat("Modelo potencia RH95:\n")
cat("Biomasa =", alpha_rh95, "* RH95^", beta_rh95, "\n\n")

# =====================================================
# 15. Gráfica RH95 lineal
# =====================================================
ggplot(biomasa_parcela,
       aes(x = rh95,
           y = biomasa_Mg_ha)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "forestgreen") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "RH95 GEDI (m)",
    y = "Biomasa Inventario (Mg/ha)",
    title = "Modelo Lineal: INFyS vs RH95"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# =====================================================
# 16. Gráfica RH95 log-log
# =====================================================
ggplot(biomasa_parcela,
       aes(x = log_rh95,
           y = log_biomasa)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2, color = "forestgreen") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "log(RH95 GEDI)",
    y = "log(Biomasa Inventario)",
    title = "Modelo Log-Log: INFyS vs RH95"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# =====================================================
# 17. Panel comparativo: AGBD vs RH95 (2x2)
# =====================================================
library(patchwork)

p1 <- ggplot(biomasa_parcela, aes(x = agbd, y = biomasa_Mg_ha)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "AGBD GEDI (Mg/ha)", y = "Biomasa INFyS (Mg/ha)",
       title = "Lineal – AGBD") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(biomasa_parcela, aes(x = rh95, y = biomasa_Mg_ha)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "forestgreen") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "RH95 GEDI (m)", y = "Biomasa INFyS (Mg/ha)",
       title = "Lineal – RH95") +
  theme_minimal()

p3 <- ggplot(biomasa_parcela, aes(x = log_agbd, y = log_biomasa)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "log(AGBD GEDI)", y = "log(Biomasa INFyS)",
       title = "Log-Log – AGBD") +
  theme_minimal()

p4 <- ggplot(biomasa_parcela, aes(x = log_rh95, y = log_biomasa)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "forestgreen") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "log(RH95 GEDI)", y = "log(Biomasa INFyS)",
       title = "Log-Log – RH95") +
  theme_minimal()

(p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Comparativo AGBD vs RH95 — GEDI x INFyS Quintana Roo 2019"
  )
```

```{r}
# =====================================================
# Preparar datos
# =====================================================
biomasa_parcela <- datos %>%
  group_by(IdConglome) %>%
  summarise(
    biomasa_total_kg = sum(biomasa_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    agbd = mean(agbd, na.rm = TRUE),
    rh95 = mean(rh95, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(biomasa_Mg_ha = biomasa_total_kg / 1000) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(agbd),
    !is.na(biomasa_Mg_ha),
    !is.na(rh95),
    biomasa_Mg_ha > 0,
    agbd > 0,
    rh95 > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_biomasa = log(biomasa_Mg_ha),
    log_agbd    = log(agbd),
    log_rh95    = log(rh95)
  )

# =====================================================
# Modelos
# =====================================================
mod_agbd_lin <- lm(biomasa_Mg_ha ~ agbd,     data = biomasa_parcela)
mod_agbd_log <- lm(log_biomasa   ~ log_agbd, data = biomasa_parcela)
mod_rh95_lin <- lm(biomasa_Mg_ha ~ rh95,     data = biomasa_parcela)
mod_rh95_log <- lm(log_biomasa   ~ log_rh95, data = biomasa_parcela)

# =====================================================
# Función para etiqueta de métricas
# =====================================================
metricas_label <- function(modelo, x, y) {
  r2   <- round(summary(modelo)$r.squared, 3)
  rmse <- round(sqrt(mean(resid(modelo)^2)), 3)
  cor_ <- round(cor(x, y), 3)
  paste0("R² = ", r2,
         "\nRMSE = ", rmse,
         "\nr = ", cor_)
}

lab_agbd_lin <- metricas_label(mod_agbd_lin,
                                biomasa_parcela$agbd,
                                biomasa_parcela$biomasa_Mg_ha)
lab_agbd_log <- metricas_label(mod_agbd_log,
                                biomasa_parcela$log_agbd,
                                biomasa_parcela$log_biomasa)
lab_rh95_lin <- metricas_label(mod_rh95_lin,
                                biomasa_parcela$rh95,
                                biomasa_parcela$biomasa_Mg_ha)
lab_rh95_log <- metricas_label(mod_rh95_log,
                                biomasa_parcela$log_rh95,
                                biomasa_parcela$log_biomasa)

# =====================================================
# Gráficas
# =====================================================
p1 <- ggplot(biomasa_parcela, aes(x = agbd, y = biomasa_Mg_ha)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
           label = lab_agbd_lin,
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3,
           size = 3.2, color = "gray20") +
  labs(x = "AGBD GEDI (Mg/ha)",
       y = "Biomasa INFyS (Mg/ha)",
       title = "Lineal – AGBD") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(biomasa_parcela, aes(x = rh95, y = biomasa_Mg_ha)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "forestgreen") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
           label = lab_rh95_lin,
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3,
           size = 3.2, color = "gray20") +
  labs(x = "RH95 GEDI (m)",
       y = "Biomasa INFyS (Mg/ha)",
       title = "Lineal – RH95") +
  theme_minimal()

p3 <- ggplot(biomasa_parcela, aes(x = log_agbd, y = log_biomasa)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
           label = lab_agbd_log,
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3,
           size = 3.2, color = "gray20") +
  labs(x = "log(AGBD GEDI)",
       y = "log(Biomasa INFyS)",
       title = "Log-Log – AGBD") +
  theme_minimal()

p4 <- ggplot(biomasa_parcela, aes(x = log_rh95, y = log_biomasa)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "forestgreen") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
```
